visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a graphic title screen featuring a bright yellow background and bold red Chinese text. (2) A young man wearing a black t-shirt sits on a plush blue sofa in a brightly lit indoor living room environment. He holds a white remote control and looks at the camera with a sudden, wide-eyed expression of shock as variety-style text overlays appear. (3) A young woman with her hair in a ponytail stands before a wall calendar; she reaches up and tears a page off to reveal the date '29'. She then turns toward the lens with an exaggerated open-mouthed expression of horror. (4) A young woman with dyed blonde hair is seen sitting at a wooden desk in a dimly lit bedroom, illuminated by a warm lamp. She stares intensely at a laptop screen before recoiling in shock with her hands near her face. (5) Two young men stand in what appears to be a public indoor hallway; one wears a yellow shirt and gestures while speaking. His companion reacts with a dramatic gasp and widened eyes as the camera zooms in slightly. (6) A transition screen appears with pink text on a yellow background, indicating a shift in the topic. (7) A man lies in bed under white sheets, attempting to use rolls of yellow tape to pin his eyelids shut in a desperate attempt to sleep. Text overlays indicate the passing of time from late night to early morning. (8) The man from the first scene is now at a desk, looking extremely fatigued with dark circles under his eyes as he stares at a computer monitor in a dark room. (9) Three students are seated at wooden desks in a classroom; two are looking at their books while the one in the middle is slumped over, fast asleep. (10) The classroom empties as the bell rings, leaving the sleeping student alone; he eventually lifts his head with a dazed and confused facial expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy comedic synth BGM starts instantly with a heavy 'impact' SFX as the title card appears. (2) A female voice speaks with a sharp, nagging tone, followed by a dramatic 'whoosh' and 'shock' SFX. A male voice yells in a high-pitched, shocked tone with high arousal. (3) A distinct 'paper tearing' SFX occurs as the woman rips the calendar. Another loud 'shock' impact sound triggers a new phase, accompanied by a female scream. (4) Rapid mouse clicking and keyboard tapping sounds are heard, followed by a sudden dramatic musical sting and another female voice shouting in realization. (5) A rhythmic dialogue exchange occurs between two males at a fast speech rate. A sudden silent pause for 0.5 seconds is followed by a loud, synchronized 'Ah!' and high-intensity comedic BGM swell. (6) A digital 'bling' transition SFX marks a new title section. (7) Soft rustling of plastic or tape is audible. A male voice whispers with low intensity and high breathiness, then transitions into a loud, strained yell of frustration. (8) Rapid mechanical keyboard typing SFX dominates the mix as a tired male voice mutters with low pitch and slow speech rate. (9) A clear, resonant 'ding-dong' school bell SFX rings. A professional narrative-style male voice announces class dismissal. (10) A moment of silence is broken by a confused groan and a post-production laugh track SFX to signal the punchline.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Multiple relatable comedic scenarios -> Climax/Punchline.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain viewers by depicting highly relatable and exaggerated reactions students have when realizing the summer holidays are ending and school is about to start, specifically focusing on the struggle of adjusting sleep schedules.
